title: How B-tree Works in 30 Minutes
summary: Use B-tree ordering to reason about equality, range predicates, NULL placement, and included columns.
learning_objectives: Predict the access path for B-tree ordering, equality, range predicates, NULLS FIRST/LAST, and INCLUDE columns from a stated query pattern.
Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE with buffers to compare estimates, actual rows, and page access.
Justify the read benefit and write-maintenance cost of the proposed index.
reflection_prompts: Which query pattern makes this index defensible?
What write or storage cost would make you remove it?
